HIV and HTLV-1 infections are uncommon among leprosy cases and contacts in Brazil and that the presence of antibodies to mycobacterial cell-wall antigens, such as lipoarabinoglycan and phenolic glycolipoprotein, may lead to cross-reaction with HIV proteins in serological testing.
